 unheededly] Cp. Byron, Childe Harold’s Pilgrimage IV lxiii l. 5: ‘An earthquake reel’d unheededly
away!’.
 isle] Cp. ‘Un queto asilo’ (A quiet refuge) in l. 19 of Dal spiro della tua mente, [è] istinta (Longman
